### A Daily Process
Author: Billy Graham
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/devotions/a-daily-process
Passage: Philippians 1:6
Points:
- Christian life is an ongoing daily journey of growth rather than just a one-time conversion.
- Believers start out as spiritual infants who must feed on God's Word and learn to walk.
- Falling down and making mistakes are common early struggles, but growth must continue.
- Believers need to rely on God's strength for daily victory instead of remaining spiritually stagnant.

### Jesus, Our Template
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/jesus-our-template
Passage: Philippians 1:6
Points:
- God is actively committed to molding our inner character into the likeness of Jesus Christ.
- Just like an apprentice uses a master pattern on a lathe, God uses His Son as our template.
- Spiritual growth often involves painful heat and friction, but God holds us securely in His will.
- Believers can take comfort knowing that God views us as His ongoing project and will finish His work.
